text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Get down! Scatter!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haa, *cough*... *wheeze*... dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I can't... lay a finger on them...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the difference in power. A 
stride that utterly captivates anyone who 
watches. Thinking I could ever match that 
was far too naive—...)

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno!? ...N-No! Run! Chase after them! 
Stay strong!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hey, hey! Head back home, head back home!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
From here on, it's a staring contest! Time 
to decide who's the worst, Mame-chin~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Only someone who can pull it off gets to 
look that pathetic. You know that already, 
don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—You wanna make 'em laugh with you instead 
of me?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Capture them, don't let them go, don't 
ease up! Chase them! Chase! —Chase 
theeeem!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fixate on your opponent! Seize them! All 
for victory!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I am well accustomed to that!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"*Cough*, haah... *wheeze*... *gasp*... 
*cough, cough*...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...B-Boss. I... I—

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno!! Win next time! I'll 
definitely... be watching next time too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rush over to her body, swaying with 
ragged breaths. For someone who strives to 
be a hero, collapsing does not suit her.
choice_data_list:
Lean on my shoulder. Let's look cool until 
the very end.

Use my shoulder. Let's stay cool right to 
the very end

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting Fenomeno's arm around my shoulder, 
we slowly move along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued to respond with dignified 
grace to the cheers from the crowd that 
reached her ears midway through.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Boss. I'll be fine from 
here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry.
choice_data_list: It's okay, you don't need to apologize

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno fell completely silent, just like 
a child who suddenly felt guilty.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss. I—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...It's all that guy's fault.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's her. ...It's all Golshi-san's 
fault.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have 
gained any of this strength.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even the "fixation on someone" that's 
needed for tracking power... Got honed 
thanks to her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even getting back on my feet today... 
yeah. It was all because of that idiot 
constantly goofing around.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I was able to stand on the right side 
in front of everyone. They saw me as an 
'ally of justice.'"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Because of that, everyone started 
cheering for me. I managed to break out of 
the binary choice of being feared as a 
monster or completely ignored.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, that's true for everything! 
Gaining strength, finding the impetus to 
get back on my feet—all of it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everything—all of it, every single 
thing—!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno confronts the emotions welling up 
inside her, and swallows them down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I gently supported her back, knowing 
she couldn't even bring herself to be 
defiant at a time like this."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what that person wanted to 
do with me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it's also possible they just 
wanted to get caught up in some crazy 
shenanigans and have a fun time, I think.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—However, that does not change the fact 
that interacting with her helped me grow.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss, regarding our plans moving 
forward, could you spare me a moment of 
your time?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I want to re-examine a lot of things. 
Including my relationship with that girl.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —About my justice as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it might be better not to 
set major goals like a GⅠ race yet. Which 
means—
choice_data_list: Shall we aim for the Nikkei Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 2,500m long-distance race held at 
Nakayama Racecourse in March. A win here 
drastically widens options for the spring 
season.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
For someone who champions justice to 
constantly be on the receiving end... 
would be rather strange, after all.
